literal: On dingyou day, Xia State's Wapu came to surrender.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Xia State's Wapu came to surrender.

literal: On jihai day, distant Yi of the Basimu tribe dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jihai day distant Yi of the Basimu tribe sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, on bingchen new moon, established the Daotaoling inspector-general.
idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month the Daotaoling inspector-general was established.

literal: On bingyin day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On gengwu day, visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at the Great Peace Hall.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the court visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at the Great Peace Hall.

literal: On renshen day, edict forbade physicians, diviners, butchers, peddlers, slaves, and those who had served as substitute parents or fled after offenses from taking the jinshi examination.
idiomatic: On renshen day an edict forbade physicians, diviners, butchers, peddlers, slaves, and those who had served as substitute parents or fled after offenses from taking the jinshi examination.

literal: Huiba, Hesuguan, and Pulumaoduo tribes each dispatched envoys presenting horses.
idiomatic: Huiba, Hesuguan, and Pulumaoduo tribes each sent envoys presenting horses.

literal: On jiaxu day, Song dispatched envoys to congratulate the victory over Xia; Goryeo envoys also arrived.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Song sent envoys to congratulate the victory over Xia; Goryeo envoys also arrived.

literal: On xinsi day, held the jinshi examination in the Golden Hall.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the jinshi examination was held in the Golden Hall.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renchen day, halted at Kuolipuwan.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the seventh autumn month the court halted at Kuolipuwan.

literal: On guisi day, made Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji head the Southern and Northern Privy Councils.
idiomatic: On guisi day Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was made head of the Southern and Northern Privy Councils.

literal: On yiwei day, Zubu chief Huedela's younger brother Wodelai came to court and was promoted Grand Master of War before being sent away.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Zubu chief Huedela's younger brother Wodelai came to court, was promoted Grand Master of War, and was sent away.

literal: On wuxu day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On wuxu day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On wushen day, made Left yilibi Xiao Tanggu Northern Court associate privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On wushen day Left yilibi Xiao Tanggu was made Northern Court associate privy commissioner.

literal: On renzi day, hunted at Houliji.
idiomatic: On renzi day the court hunted at Houliji.

literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day, Zubu chieftain Chuanzhige Balisi came to court.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the eighth month Zubu chieftain Chuanzhige Balisi came to court.

literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, Xia troops invaded the border; Dilugu dispatched Six Courts general Haili and defeated them.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the ninth month Xia troops invaded the border; Dilugu dispatched Six Courts general Haili and defeated them.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengwu day, returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On gengwu day of the tenth winter month the court returned to the Supreme Capital.

literal: On xinwei day, Li Liangzuo's mother in Xia State dispatched envoys begging to resume vassal status as before.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Li Liangzuo's mother in Xia State sent envoys begging to resume vassal status as before.

literal: When the envoys returned, an edict instructed them to send another trusted minister to the court separately; the matter would be considered at leisure.
idiomatic: When the envoys returned, an edict instructed them to send another trusted minister to the court separately; the matter would be considered at leisure.

literal: On renshen day, released convict laborers of Linhuang Prefecture.
idiomatic: On renshen day convict laborers of Linhuang Prefecture were released.

literal: On jiaxu day, went to Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court went to Zhonghuichuan.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, Zubu chieftain Huedela dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the eleventh month Zubu chieftain Huedela sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengxu day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On gengxu day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On renzi day, dismissed Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai as Wuding Army military commissioner, associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as Changning Army military commissioner, Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze, Zhang You as prefect of Hui, and drafting edict commissioner Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.
idiomatic: On renzi day Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai was dismissed as Wuding Army military commissioner, associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as Changning Army military commissioner, Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze, Zhang You as prefect of Hui, and drafting edict commissioner Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.

literal: Intercalary month, on yimao day, made Prince of Han Tiebu regent of the Central Capital.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yimao day, Prince of Han Tiebu was made regent of the Central Capital.

literal: On xinwei day, made associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge Southern Court privy commissioner, Southern Court great king Yelü Renxian to administer Northern Court privy affairs, and enfeoffed him Prince of Song.
idiomatic: On xinwei day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner; Southern Court great king Yelü Renxian was appointed to administer Northern Court privy affairs and enfeoffed Prince of Song.

literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was dismissed as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the twelfth month Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was dismissed as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.

literal: On gengxu day, Prince of Han Xiao Hui was transferred to Prince of Wei and retired.
idiomatic: On gengxu day Prince of Han Xiao Hui was transferred to Prince of Wei and retired.

literal: On renzi day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting a memorial begging to resume subject status as before.
idiomatic: On renzi day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting a memorial begging to resume subject status as before.

literal: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, on wuxu day, halted at the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on wuxu day of the first spring month the court halted at the Huntong River.

literal: Second month, on jiashen day, dispatched former Northern Court inspector-general Xiao Youkuo and others as envoys to Xia State to demand Tangut rebel households.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the second month former Northern Court inspector-general Xiao Youkuo and others were dispatched as envoys to Xia State to demand Tangut rebel households.

literal: On jichou day, went to Canger Marsh.
idiomatic: On jichou day the court went to Canger Marsh.

literal: On jiachen day, Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, on renzi new moon, visited Heishui.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the third month the court visited Heishui.

literal: Summer, fifth month, on guichou day, Xiao Youkuo and others returned from Xia; Li Liangzuo's mother memorialized begging to present horses, camels, cattle, and sheep as Tangut custom allowed.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the fifth summer month Xiao Youkuo and others returned from Xia; Li Liangzuo's mother memorialized begging to present horses, camels, cattle, and sheep as Tangut custom allowed.

literal: On jisi day, Xia State dispatched envoys requesting Tanglong Post and begging to abandon fortified towns they had built; answered by edict.
idiomatic: On jisi day Xia State sent envoys requesting Tanglong Post and begging to abandon fortified towns they had built; the court answered by edict.

literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day, edict ordered Li Yuanhao's wife captured earlier and Xia people captured before and after to be settled in Su Prefecture.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the sixth month an edict ordered Li Yuanhao's wife captured earlier and Xia people captured before and after to be settled in Su Prefecture.

literal: Goods captured in the Xia campaign were sent by envoys as gifts to Song.
idiomatic: Goods captured in the Xia campaign were sent by envoys as gifts to Song.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: Ninth month, edict ordered regulations to be revised anew.
idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict ordered regulations to be revised anew.

literal: Halted at Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: The court halted at Zhonghuichuan.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jimao new moon, registered military rolls in all circuits.
idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the tenth winter month military rolls in all circuits were registered.

literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen day, made tiyin inspector-general Xiao Molu Left yilibi.
idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eleventh month tiyin inspector-general Xiao Molu was made Left yilibi.

literal: On jiazi day, ordered the Eastern Capital regent's office to oversee Household and Inner Court affairs in general.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the Eastern Capital regent's office was ordered to oversee Household and Inner Court affairs in general.

literal: On dingmao day, abolished the censor's office of recording officials' offenses; ordered drafting edict commissioners to oversee it in general.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the censor's office of recording officials' offenses was abolished; drafting edict commissioners were ordered to oversee it in general.

literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, went to the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

literal: Second month, went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, made imperial maternal uncle detail-stable Xiao Ala Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Xiping.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the fourth summer month imperial maternal uncle detail-stable Xiao Ala was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping.

literal: Sixth month, on bingzi day, halted at Yongan Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the sixth month the court halted at Yongan Mountain.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen new moon, summoned Northern Court chancellor Xiao Taliege, Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Tiebu, Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge, and Renxian, who administered Northern Court privy affairs; granted them seats and discussed the ways of governing ancient and modern times.
idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the seventh autumn month Northern Court chancellor Xiao Taliege, Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Tiebu, Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge, and Renxian, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, were summoned; they were granted seats and discussed the ways of governing ancient and modern times.

literal: On wushen day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On wushen day Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.

literal: On jiyou day, edict ordered the Northern and Southern Privy Councils to memorialize twice daily.
idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered the Northern and Southern Privy Councils to memorialize twice daily.

literal: On renzi day, posthumously honored Taizu's grandfather as Emperor Jianxian, temple name Xuanzu, and his grandmother as Empress Jianxian;
idiomatic: On renzi day Taizu's grandfather was posthumously honored as Emperor Jianxian, temple name Xuanzu, and his grandmother as Empress Jianxian;

literal: Taizu's father as Emperor Xuanjian, temple name Dezu, and his mother as Empress Xuanjian.
idiomatic: Taizu's father was honored as Emperor Xuanjian, temple name Dezu, and his mother as Empress Xuanjian.

literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu as Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.
idiomatic: Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu Prince of Sui.

literal: Made Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and administrator of tiyin affairs, and granted him an edict of instruction.
idiomatic: Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and administrator of tiyin affairs, and granted an edict of instruction.

literal: On guihai day, attendant junior attendant Lu Baofei forged the imperial hand; death was remitted and he was sentenced to corvée for life.
idiomatic: On guihai day attendant junior attendant Lu Baofei forged the imperial hand; death was remitted and he was sentenced to corvée for life.

literal: On jiazi day, went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: On wuchen day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Made Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge Northern Court privy commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Wu.
idiomatic: Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was made Northern Court privy commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

literal: On xinwei day, went to Qing Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the court went to Qing Prefecture.

literal: On renshen day, posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's younger brother Yindishi as Prince of Xu.
idiomatic: On renshen day Taizu's younger brother Yindishi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.

literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day, Grand Master of War Wuzhe died; edict ordered him to share sacrifice in Shengzong's temple.
idiomatic: On wuzi day of the eighth month Grand Master of War Wuzhe died; an edict ordered him to share sacrifice in Shengzong's temple.

literal: Ninth month, on yimao day, Ping Prefecture presented a white hare.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the ninth month Ping Prefecture presented a white hare.

literal: On jiwei day, paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

literal: On gengshen day, posthumously advanced honorific titles for the Shangsi Sage Emperor and the Tianshun Emperor, and changed Empress Zhangde's posthumous title to Jing'an.
idiomatic: On gengshen day honorific titles were posthumously advanced for the Shangsi Sage Emperor and the Tianshun Emperor, and Empress Zhangde's posthumous title was changed to Jing'an.

literal: On guihai day, posthumous title for Empress Qitian was changed to Empress Rende.
idiomatic: On guihai day the posthumous title for Empress Qitian was changed to Empress Rende.

literal: On jiazi day, paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

literal: Taizu's honorific was increased to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martyr, Heavenly Emperor; Empress Zhenlie's title was changed to Chunqin; Emperor Gongshun to Zhangsu; Empress Xiao's title to Hejing.
idiomatic: Taizu's honorific was increased to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martyr, Heavenly Emperor; Empress Zhenlie's title was changed to Chunqin; Emperor Gongshun to Zhangsu; and Empress Xiao's title to Hejing.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin day, halted at Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghuichuan.

literal: On dinghai day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys begging relaxation of border defenses; immediately dispatched Xiao Youkuo to convey the edict of instruction.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys begging relaxation of border defenses; Xiao Youkuo was immediately dispatched to convey the edict of instruction.

literal: On wuzi day, visited Xian and Yi prefectures.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court visited Xian and Yi prefectures.

literal: On jiawu day, Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng; Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu Chage was made Southern Court privy commissioner and advanced to Prince of Yue.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie was enfeoffed Prince of Zheng; Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu Chage was made Southern Court privy commissioner and advanced to Prince of Yue.

literal: On wuxu day, shot tigers at Nansagebo.
idiomatic: On wuxu day tigers were shot at Nansagebo.

literal: On xinchou day, paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

literal: Eleventh month, on renyin new moon, advanced Emperor Wenxian's honorific to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi, and posthumous titles for the two empresses to Duanshun and Rouzhen.
idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the eleventh month Emperor Wenxian's honorific was advanced to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi, and posthumous titles for the two empresses to Duanshun and Rouzhen.

literal: Again changed Shizong's Empress Xiaolie posthumous title to Huaijie.
idiomatic: Shizong's Empress Xiaolie posthumous title was again changed to Huaijie.

literal: On dingwei day, advanced Emperor Xiaocheng's honorific to Emperor Xiaocheng, Kangjing, and changed Empress Shengshen, Xuanxian posthumous title to Ruizhi.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Emperor Xiaocheng's honorific was advanced to Emperor Xiaocheng, Kangjing, and Empress Shengshen, Xuanxian posthumous title was changed to Ruizhi.

literal: On jiazi day, halted at Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court halted at Zhonghuichuan.

literal: Uighur Asalan dispatched envoys presenting famous horses and literary leopards.
idiomatic: Uighur Asalan sent envoys presenting famous horses and literary leopards.

literal: On bingyin day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On bingyin day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Twelfth month, on wuxu day, made Northern Court chancellor Taliege Nanjing supreme commander, Prince of Zheng Xulie Northern Court chancellor, and Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yixian tiyin.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the twelfth month Northern Court chancellor Taliege was made Nanjing supreme commander, Prince of Zheng Xulie Northern Court chancellor, and Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yixian tiyin.

literal: Released convict laborers whose term limit had expired.
idiomatic: Convict laborers whose term limit had expired were released.

literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, on yisi day, went to the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on yisi day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

literal: Second month, on bingzi day, Uighur Asalan was invaded by a neighboring state and dispatched envoys seeking aid.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the second month Uighur Asalan was invaded by a neighboring state and sent envoys seeking aid.

literal: On gengchen day, went to spring waters.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the court went to spring waters.

literal: Third month, on guihai day, Li Liangzuo, because the granted edict permitted surrender, dispatched envoys to give thanks.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the third month Li Liangzuo, because the granted edict permitted surrender, sent envoys to give thanks.

literal: On bingyin day, went to Heishui Marsh.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court went to Heishui Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuzi day.
idiomatic: On wuzi day of the fourth summer month

literal: Hunted at Hedan.
idiomatic: the court hunted at Hedan.

literal: Fifth month, on renyin day, edict ordered inland prefectures and counties to plant fruit trees.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the fifth month an edict ordered inland prefectures and counties to plant fruit trees.

literal: Sixth month, on renshen day, halted at Hulü Mountain.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the sixth month the court halted at Hulü Mountain.

literal: On guimao day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On guimao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiyou day, Zubu great king Tutugu led various tribal chiefs presenting horses and camels.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the seventh autumn month Zubu great king Tutugu led various tribal chiefs presenting horses and camels.

literal: On gengshen day, went to Heiling.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court went to Heiling.

literal: Intercalary month, on gengwu day, Wugu came with tribute.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, Wugu came with tribute.

literal: On guisi day, established the Money and Silks Office at Changchun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guisi day the Money and Silks Office was established at Changchun Prefecture.

literal: Ninth month, on renchen day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting a surrender memorial.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the ninth month Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting a surrender memorial.
